oracle.statement: for 3 never-created syntactically-legal b2cget_* names (never PUT), GET describe returns HTTP 404 with a body carrying an error indication (name / 'not found' / 'error', case-insensitive); HTTP 200 = Type1_IllegalSuccess (config for a nonexistent collection, the assertion's primary defect class), other 4xx = Type4_StateLogicViolation, 5xx = Type3_RuntimeFailure, 404 with no error indication at all = Type2_PoorDiagnostics
